mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.school_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.enabled, r.role_code, st.id AS student_id, t.id AS teacher_id, g.id AS guardian_id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.enabled = TRUE LEFT JOIN student st ON st.user_id = u.id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.user_id = u.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN guardian g ON g.user_id = u.id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE u.username = #{username} AND (u.school_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM school s WHERE s.id = u.school_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' )) LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.school_id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.enabled, r.role_code, st.id AS student_id, t.id AS teacher_id, g.id AS guardian_id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.enabled = TRUE LEFT JOIN student st ON st.user_id = u.id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.user_id = u.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN guardian g ON g.user_id = u.id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.enabled = TRUE AND (u.school_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM school s WHERE s.id = u.school_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' )) AND ( r.role_code != 'STUDENT' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student st WHERE st.user_id = u.id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) AND ( r.role_code != 'TEACHER' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teacher t WHERE t.user_id = u.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) AND ( r.role_code != 'GUARDIAN' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM guardian g WHERE g.user_id = u.id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' ) )
